supply_lessons.alm-hq: Lesson from January 2024: the M7.0 border earthquake stopped the metro for five hours and sent people into the cold at night; a Verny-type event would also cut the Almaty-Khorgos corridor, so alternative routes via Dostyk and Aktau matter.
supply_lessons.aty-branch: Lesson from spring 2024: the Zhaiyk flood cut the Dossor-Kulsary road and delayed Tengiz convoys for weeks; stock 2-3 weeks of critical parts in Atyrau and agree an air-freight fallback.
supply_lessons.tas-office: Lesson from July 2025-2026: heat waves push the grid to record loads and cause district outages; suppliers in Chirchik and Angren run at reduced margins above 42 C.
supply_lessons.bis-office: Lesson from the 2018 CHP failure: a single plant outage left Bishkek without heating at -25 C; keep generator fuel and plan for winter power deficits.
supply_lessons.dus-office: Lesson from spring mudflows: access roads to the Vakhsh valley projects close for days; keep buffer stocks and schedule deliveries outside the April-May peak.
supply_lessons.ash-office: Lesson from Caspian logistics: ferry and port schedules slip with storms and low water; keep a rail alternative via Kazakhstan and 3 weeks of inventory.
